rows.label: ELEVEN
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one

rows.label: INTEGER
rows.clue: Any of the natural numbers (positive or negative) or zero

rows.label: YARD
rows.clue: A unit of length equal to 3 feet

rows.label: THIRD
rows.clue: One of three equal parts of a divisible whole

rows.label: FATHOM
rows.clue: A linear unit of measurement (equal to 6 feet) for water depth

rows.label: SEA ROOM
rows.clue: Space for maneuver at sea

rows.label: PARKING
rows.clue: Space in which vehicles can be parked

rows.label: FILL
rows.clue: A quantity sufficient to satisfy

rows.label: FIFTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and five

rows.label: FIVE
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of four and one

rows.label: MAXIMUM
rows.clue: The largest possible quantity

rows.label: MORSEL
rows.clue: A small quantity of anything

rows.label: GEE
rows.clue: A unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity

rows.label: BILLION
rows.clue: The number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros

rows.label: WON
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in South Korea

rows.label: DRY QUART
rows.clue: A United States dry unit equal to 2 pints or 67.2 cubic inches

rows.label: EIGHT
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of seven and one

rows.label: TEN
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one

rows.label: POUND
rows.clue: 16 ounces avoirdupois

rows.label: SIXTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and six

rows.label: MILLION
rows.clue: The number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros

rows.label: DIVISOR
rows.clue: One of two or more integers that can be exactly divided into another integer

rows.label: SKELETON
rows.clue: Something reduced to its minimal form

rows.label: SPOONFUL
rows.clue: As much as a spoon will hold

rows.label: INCH
rows.clue: A unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

rows.label: HEAT UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of measurement for work

rows.label: ACRE INCH
rows.clue: One twelfth of an acre-foot

rows.label: WHISKER
rows.clue: A very small distance or space

rows.label: GRAM ATOM
rows.clue: The quantity of an element whose weight in grams is numerically equal to the atomic weight of the element

rows.label: OUNCE
rows.clue: A unit of apothecary weight equal to 480 grains or one twelfth of a pound

rows.label: REAL
rows.clue: Any rational or irrational number

rows.label: SEVENTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven

rows.label: RATIONAL
rows.clue: An integer or a fraction

rows.label: PAIN UNIT
rows.clue: A unit measuring the intensity of pain

rows.label: AIR MILE
rows.clue: A unit of length used in navigation

rows.label: PAR
rows.clue: (golf) the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire course

rows.label: MOUTHFUL
rows.clue: The quantity that can be held in the mouth

rows.label: GRAND
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100

rows.label: NINETY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine
